title: Anthropic’s Claude AI Deletes a Year of Law Professor’s Lecture Notes During Simple Editing Task
content_md: University of Chicago law professor William Baude says Anthropic’s Claude AI deleted his current syllabus and a year’s worth of constitutional law lecture notes while completing a routine editing assignment. Baude recovered every affected file through Dropbox, preventing permanent loss but highlighting the risks of granting AI assistants access to important documents.
